SUBJECT: SURVEY FORGADO TREATMENTS

Brown & Williamson Tobacco Corporation
LOUISVILLE L. KENTUCKY
INTERNAL CORRESPONDENCE

1980年

RAD, with the assistance of Manufacturing and Leaf Departments, will shortly initiate two large-scale experiments involving treatments of sugar. The first time is prior to redrying and storage. Experimental designs of these are appended. One experiment involves the additive of et al. of the sugars from a non-membranulated barley increasing following a threaded can on barley strips, followed by redrying and storage. This is directed toward silkwants using a single method for barley redrying as a primary facility. This possibility was first discussed at the August F.D.C. Meeting. The planned program described in the appended write-up was developed in discussions between RAD, Leaf and Manufacturing Departments.

The other experiment is an extension to hogshed scale of a promising technique developed by R&D to accelerate the aging of barley by the addition of a sugar-amino acid-selt mixture to unaged tobacco.
The two lines of work are very similar in terms of tobacco preparation, and it is planned to case and ready tobacco for the two studies concurrently. Evaluation of the results obtained from each experiment will be facilitated by reoming the experiment as the same time.
